Paragraph:
"""
**Riverside pilot**

At Monday's meeting, the council agreed to fund a six-month transport pilot, not a permanent service. The plan has not yet started. If the independent safety review is completed before 15 December, the first buses will run in January; otherwise, the launch will be delayed. Dr. Maya Chen said that approval of the funding should not be confused with approval to begin carrying passengers. No date for a permanent service has been agreed.

Applicants under 18 cannot join the passenger panel. People aged 18 or over may apply, but applications received after Friday will not be considered unless the delay was caused by the council's own website. Successful applicants will be notified within seven working days, excluding weekends and public holidays. They will receive a travel pass, but they will not be paid for attending meetings.

The pilot follows a small, voluntary survey. In one neighbourhood, the share of respondents willing to use the bus rose from 40% to 50%. That is an increase of 10 percentage points, or a relative increase of 25%; it is not a 10% relative increase. Not all respondents had previously used public transport. Because the survey was voluntary and the two neighbourhoods differed in income and distance from the station, the council did not claim that cheaper fares caused the change.

The published budget includes drivers and routine maintenance but excludes major repairs. Any proposal to increase the budget must return to the council for a separate vote. Fewer than five residents complained about the proposed timetable, which does not mean that every other resident supported it: most residents did not respond. The council will publish the full figures rather than only the positive comments.

The final report must distinguish observed changes from predicted benefits. Even if passenger numbers rise, that alone will not establish whether the service reduced car journeys. A permanent service will be considered only after the pilot has ended and the external assessment has been published.
